_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Key Supplier Facilitization Investment Schedules and Financial Reports
summary: This DID governs Key Supplier Facilitization Investment schedules and financial reports used to assess program financial performance, facilitization investments, and resource allocation.
use_relationship:
The Government will secure from the Key Suppliers notional Key Supplier Facilitization Investment schedules, reflecting the timing and amount of each Key Supplier's specific Facilitization Investments. The Key Suppliers' Facilitization Investment schedules will be finalized and incorporated into the MYP Contract award and all Key Supplier MYP subcontracts. The Facilitization Investment Schedule will be updated to reflect the timing and amount of specific Facilitization Investments that the Contractor and its Suppliers (other than Key Suppliers) are expected to make. This model will serve as a comprehensive tool for assessing program financial performance, facilitization investments and resource allocation.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

children.title: The Financial Model shall be delivered in electronic format (e.g. excel or PDF) to ensure compatibility with government systems.
The Facilitization schedules shall be delivered in MS projects.

On a quarterly basis, the Contractor shall deliver to the Government a report of financial results, mapped to the Financial Model, including a report of cumulative Facilitization Investments expended, mapped to the Contractor's Facilitization Investment Schedule.
children.content: The Key Suppliers shall deliver to the Contractor and Government a report of cumulative Key Supplier Facilitization Investments expended, mapped to the Key Supplier's Facilitization Investment schedule.

children.title: The Financial Model shall include the following components:
Income Statement
children.content: Program earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA).

children.title: Program Cash Flow Statement
children.content: Detailed cash flow projections for the program.

children.title: Facilitization Investment Schedule
children.content: Timing and amount of specific facilitization investments the Contractor intends to make.

children.title: Statement of Current Assets and Liabilities
children.content: A detailed statement of current assets and current liabilities.

children.title: The facilitization investment schedule shall be updated to reflect the timing and amount of specific investments expected from the Contractor and its suppliers (excluding key suppliers).
children.content: The facilitization investment schedules shall be inclusive of all tasking needed to increase capacity at all suppliers and link back to the financial model.

children.title: The Financial Model must be complete, accurate, and certified by the Contractor.
The Financial Model must align with GAAP standards and include all required components as outlined above.
The facilitization investment schedule must reflect finalized agreements with suppliers and provide clear traceability of investments.
